note: Set A keeps most dimensions attached to the correct elevation blocks (e.g., MWL01 and the 2'‑11 3/16" / 3'‑9 11/16" segments in West Living, 3'‑6 1/4" in North Living, the 1/2"=1'-0" scale), though it pads the set with vague entities like "interior elevation"/"Wall section" and repeats the 7'‑2 1/2" and 3'‑9 11/16" values. Set B scrambles the elevation-to-dimension mapping badly: 9'‑10 1/4", 3'‑6" and 8'‑8" come from the A1 South Bedroom block but are labeled North/West Bedroom, 9'‑2" and 4 1/2" come from the C5 block but are labeled West/South Bedroom, and MWD01/MWD02 are placed in North Bedroom although they appear in the A1/A3 blocks. Set B does capture the artwork note ("SEE ARTWORK PKG FOR SIZE & MOUNT LOCATIONS") and correctly places TV in West Living and MWD02/P2 in the bedroom elevations, but it also invents conditions such as "center point X", "Detail A3" and "above MWD01". Overall Set A has fewer misbound and invented claims, so it is the better extraction despite its vagueness.
